race.comment: PERCIPIENT (9) debuted behind KOKESHI here over 1200m and wasn't far away when respected by the market. Can only improve off that and will relish any extra distance he gets, especially from a better gate here. ABYDOS (1) just found one better over this trip at Hamilton last start and gets Williams aboard to offset a tricky gate. RED TIDE (11) put in a career best at Geelong last time out over this distance and comes under notice from a good gate with D Lane booked. FORT ROCK (7) is a Tassort gelding on debut who can run well. SOUNDWAVE (5) ran in the middle of the pack last start at Ballarat when fresh. Is up in distance today, could threaten.
